articles.title: Capes scholarship holders say that change in visa rules delays the start of internships in Spain
articles.summary: Dozens of Brazilian scholarship holders supported by Capes report that a recent change in Spain’s visa rules has delayed the start of their research internships in the country. The delays have led to financial losses, including expenses for insurance and rebooking of travel tickets.
articles.insight:
This incident highlights growing visa policy volatility in key study destinations, potentially amplifying perceptions among Latin American students that bureaucratic hurdles and financial risks are rising—though direct shifts in demand toward Anglophone countries remain unproven and context-dependent.  
Admissions teams should monitor regional sentiment shifts via student surveys and agent feedback, particularly regarding Spain’s reputation for research mobility, while reviewing pre-departure support offerings to address emerging concerns about visa-related disruptions and cost unpredictability.
